upstream.notes: The daily planet build at build.protomaps.com. Resolved through https://build-metadata.protomaps.dev/builds.json: the bucket root has no listing and there is no 'latest' alias. Set currentBuild after the first real extract.

notes: HOSTED, although the spec's pack table calls roads 'Linked'. Neither Protomaps nor Geofabrik publishes a per-state PMTiles file: Protomaps publishes one ~130 GB planet archive, Geofabrik publishes .osm.pbf data, not tiles. The per-state extract has to be built and hosted by us. See the hosting note at the top of scripts/extract_maps.py.
